title: The Immunogenicity of Intradermal Influenza Vaccination in Hemodialysis Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether half-dose intradermal influenza vaccine is as immunogenic as standard dose intramuscular vaccine in hemodialysis patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients under chronic hemodialysis

Exclusion Criteria:

* history of flu infection in last month
* history of flu vaccination in 2009
* hospitalization in last month
* taking immune suppressants drugs
* hemodialysis less than twice weekly
